title: Maserati Onion (Maserati F1): Characteristics
metaDescription: Maserati onion is an F1 hybrid onion variety from Ramgo. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: Maserati onion is an F1 hybrid onion variety, also sold or known as Maserati F1 or Maserati shallot. It is not a registered variety, so the facts here come from its seller and farm sources. It comes from Ramgo.

heroImage.alt: Onion plants in beds separated by grassy paths on a Philippine farm, the kind of farm where Maserati onion is grown

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Maserati F1 or Maserati shallot, this is the same onion. The facts below come from its seller and from farm sources, each one listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [onion variety finder](/crop-varieties/onion), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Land preparation for onion and garlic](/land-preparation/onion-garlic-land-preparation).

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Days to harvest, by the seller's count: harvest about 85 days after transplanting. Yield, by the seller's count: 35 to 40 t/ha potential (company figure). No trial on record checks these figures yet, so treat them as the seller's own and compare with farms near you before you plan a season around it.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit onion fields most often: [leafminer](/pests/leafminer), [onion armyworm](/pests/onion-armyworm), [purple blotch of onion](/diseases/purple-blotch), [anthracnose](/diseases/anthracnose), [bacterial soft rot](/diseases/soft-rot). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Days to harvest:** Harvest about 85 days after transplanting.
**Fruit:** Bulb: hybrid shallot, mostly 2 to 3 bulbs a plant, shiny deep red with several skins.

blocks.text: These are the seller's own figures, from its own trials. So plant a small area first, and compare it with your usual onion on the same ground.
Where and when to plant Maserati onion

Red onion stores longer, while yellow onion yields more. Pick a variety that bulbs in the short days of the Philippine dry season, and plant it after the rains so the bulbs dry well. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng gulay](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-gulay).

items.q: Is Maserati F1 the same as Maserati?
items.a: Yes. Maserati F1 is another name for Maserati. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.
No. It is a hybrid, so seed saved from it does not grow true and yields less. Buy new seed each season.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Maserati?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
